description: This file defines an Express router for product-related endpoints, including 'ping', 'add', 'remove', 'list', and 'update', and imports controller functions for handling these routes.

methods.name: GET /ping
methods.description: A lightweight endpoint to verify router mounting and controller import health. Returns a simple JSON response indicating OK status.

methods.name: POST /add
methods.description: Endpoint to add a new product, handled by addProduct controller.

methods.name: DELETE /remove
methods.description: Endpoint to remove an existing product, handled by removeProduct controller.

methods.name: GET /list
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a list of products, handled by listProducts controller.

methods.name: POST /update
methods.description: Endpoint to update product information, handled by updateProduct controller.
